families.title: One-second latency and throughput
families.sample_unit: one-second interval nested within five independent host runs per condition
families.how_to_read: Read latency and throughput in separate unit panels; interval rows show within-run evolution and are not independent replicates.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; no numerical pattern is frozen by this contract.
families.limits: Intervals are bounded summaries, not per-message traces, and do not replace aggregate estimators.

families.title: Fine-grid capacity knee
families.sample_unit: five independent host runs at one system and offered rate
families.how_to_read: Follow each system across offered rate and stop SUT-only interpretation at the first delivery-bad MQTT-loopback rate.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; the first good-to-bad transition is not predeclared.
families.limits: The grid brackets a knee but does not identify an untested maximum or replace E-Perf-10.

families.title: Run-level delivery-good frequency
families.sample_unit: delivery-good indicator for each of five independent host runs at one system and rate
families.how_to_read: The plotted proportion is the descriptive fraction of five runs meeting the per-run delivery rule; the frozen pooled-loss estimator remains authoritative.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; no success probability is assumed in advance.
families.limits: N=5 proportions are descriptive and MQTT support-path censoring applies at and above the first bad support rate.

families.title: Refined payload-size knee
families.sample_unit: one independent host run at one exact emitted payload size
families.how_to_read: Use the logarithmic payload axis and compare run-level latency distributions without fitting a threshold before inspecting residuals.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; the transition location remains unknown.
families.limits: This in-process boundary-cost study does not replace canonical E-Perf-4 or use MQTT/load-generator latency.

families.title: Extended depth latency and RSS
families.sample_unit: one independent host run at one pipeline depth
families.how_to_read: Read latency and RSS panels from the same run population and inspect departures from linear scaling rather than assuming a line.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; no linearity or knee claim is precommitted.
families.limits: The six depths retain identical transform behavior and are not pooled with E-Perf-3, E-Perf-6, or E-Perf-8.

families.title: Actual-t0 10 ms swap window
families.sample_unit: 10 ms bucket nested within one of five independent host runs
families.how_to_read: Align runs at the recorded event t0 and use the fine view only to inspect local shape around the event.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; no disruption shape is assumed.
families.limits: The fine window never replaces canonical 100 ms loss accounting or E-Swap-4 primary/drain reconciliation.

families.title: Independent swap session hierarchy
families.sample_unit: swap event nested within five independent host runs
families.how_to_read: Compare five run-level summaries for first-use AOT and cached events; event points within a run show variation, not extra replication.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; first-use and cached results remain separate.
families.limits: E-Swap-2 and E-Swap-6 remain aliases of E-Swap-1 and cannot inflate candidate N.

families.title: Independent rollback session hierarchy
families.sample_unit: rollback event nested within five independent host runs
families.how_to_read: Compare run-level first-use and cached rollback summaries while retaining all nested event outcomes for audit.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; rollback variability is not assumed.
families.limits: Rejected plugins do not create sink-observed version transitions; no fabricated swap timeline is required.

families.title: Thermal and host load ladder
families.sample_unit: one-second interval nested within one clean-boot host characterization session
families.how_to_read: Follow the fixed phase order and treat any stopped phase as a failed admission rather than a missing value.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the real clean-boot characterization; synthetic fixtures cannot establish an observation.
families.limits: This is host admission evidence, not an independent performance population, and the ladder never sustains throttling intentionally.

families.title: USB throughput and integrity
families.sample_unit: USB phase within one clean-boot host characterization session
families.how_to_read: Interpret throughput only when the phase completed with matching SHA-256, stable boot ID, no kernel I/O error, and zero throttling.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the qualified exFAT volume is exercised; no synthetic throughput is evidence.
families.limits: The USB corpus is an integrity and headroom diagnostic, not a total-input-power measurement.

families.title: eKuiper tail and process-metric association
families.sample_unit: one independent host run at one rate and profiler state
families.how_to_read: Compare matched profiled and unprofiled-control runs by rate and run index, then inspect process metrics only where explicitly available.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the isolated diagnostic runs; no GC event or causal pattern is assumed.
families.limits: eKuiper 2.1.0 GC/runtime events are unavailable in this deployment; associations cannot establish GC causality.

families.title: PMIC internal-rail proxy efficiency
units: messages/second per PMIC internal-rail proxy watt
families.sample_unit: one-second interval nested within five independent host runs per condition
families.how_to_read: Compare delivered throughput divided by the matched PMIC internal-rail proxy only when both interval values are available.
families.observed_n5_pattern: PENDING until the expanded N=5 rehearsal; no efficiency ranking is predeclared.
families.limits: The denominator excludes USB current, directly connected 5 V devices, PMIC losses, and supply losses; it is never total input power.
